levels.meaning: The run is only a plan or has unresolved blockers. Do not hand off executable replay code.
Runtime or hook evidence exists, but replay parity is not accepted. Preserve evidence and unknowns.
Replay has accepted samples with no divergence, but final delivery artifacts may still need packaging.
Replay is accepted and delivery artifacts are present with no high-risk unresolved signer, cookie, or transport blocker.

required_for_delivery_ready: claim-set has at least one verified runtime or replay claim
risk-summary has no high replay or runtime blocker
